WITH base AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.net_amount, s.store_id, s.format, p.category
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period=2
)
SELECT 'rows' k, count(*)::VARCHAR v FROM base
UNION ALL SELECT 'distinct sales_line_id', count(DISTINCT sales_line_id)::VARCHAR FROM base
UNION ALL SELECT 'distinct receipt+line', count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no))::VARCHAR FROM base
UNION ALL SELECT 'store999 rows', count(*)::VARCHAR FROM base WHERE store_id=999
UNION ALL SELECT 'ZZ rows', count(*)::VARCHAR FROM base WHERE category='ZZ Test'
UNION ALL SELECT 'format:'||coalesce(format,'NULL')||' store<900 '||(store_id<900)::VARCHAR, count(*)::VARCHAR FROM base GROUP BY format, (store_id<900)
UNION ALL SELECT 'returns total rows', count(*)::VARCHAR FROM fact_return_line
UNION ALL SELECT 'returns distinct id', count(DISTINCT return_line_id)::VARCHAR FROM fact_return_line
UNION ALL SELECT 'returns per sales_line >1', count(*)::VARCHAR FROM (SELECT sales_line_id FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'returns orphan', count(*)::VARCHAR FROM fact_return_line r LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line f USING (sales_line_id) WHERE f.sales_line_id IS NULL

WITH sold AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.net_amount, f.quantity, s.store_id, s.format AS fmt_asof_sale, cs.format AS fmt_current
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id=s.store_id AND cs.is_current
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period=2 AND s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
), r AS (SELECT sales_line_id, sum(refund_net) refund_net, sum(quantity_returned) qr, max(return_date) lastret FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1)
SELECT 'fmt mismatch lines' k, count(*)::VARCHAR v FROM sold WHERE fmt_asof_sale<>fmt_current
UNION ALL SELECT 'refund>net lines', count(*)::VARCHAR FROM sold JOIN r USING(sales_line_id) WHERE r.refund_net>sold.net_amount+0.005
UNION ALL SELECT 'qty returned>sold', count(*)::VARCHAR FROM sold JOIN r USING(sales_line_id) WHERE r.qr>sold.quantity
UNION ALL SELECT 'neg/zero net lines', count(*)::VARCHAR FROM sold WHERE net_amount<=0
UNION ALL SELECT 'lines with returns', count(*)::VARCHAR FROM sold JOIN r USING(sales_line_id)
UNION ALL SELECT 'latest return date', max(lastret)::VARCHAR FROM sold JOIN r USING(sales_line_id)
UNION ALL SELECT 'sum sold', sum(net_amount)::VARCHAR FROM sold
UNION ALL SELECT 'sum refund', sum(refund_net)::VARCHAR FROM sold JOIN r USING(sales_line_id)
UNION ALL SELECT 'refund<0', count(*)::VARCHAR FROM fact_return_line WHERE refund_net<=0

SELECT w.status, count(DISTINCT w.web_order_id) orders, count(*) lines, sum(f.net_amount) net,
       count(r.sales_line_id) lines_returned, sum(r.refund_net) refund,
       min(f.sale_date) mn, max(f.sale_date) mx
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
LEFT JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
LEFT JOIN fact_return_line r ON r.sales_line_id=f.sales_line_id
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period=2 AND s.store_id=900
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH sold_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sales_line_id, cs.format, f.net_amount
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_store cs  ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN dim_date d    ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period = 2
),
refunds AS (
    SELECT sales_line_id, SUM(refund_net) AS refund_net FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT l.format,
       ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0) / SUM(l.net_amount), 2) AS return_rate_pct,
       SUM(l.net_amount) AS sold_net, COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0) AS returned_net
FROM sold_lines l
LEFT JOIN refunds r USING (sales_line_id)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
